aspect: The dead young man is presumed to have been involved
description: 'Andaba en algo' - he was into something - is the default public and frequently official reading of a murdered young man, which reduces investigative urgency and shames the family into silence.
energy_note: Assumed to have deserved it, by default.

aspect: Asylum frameworks are built around other profiles
description: Protection categories are more legible for women, families and children; a young man fleeing forced recruitment (CAR-001) presents as the demographic the system is screening for.
energy_note: Fleeing the gang makes him look like the gang.

aspect: He is less likely to be believed about fear
description: Credible-fear determinations turn on plausibility judgments in which a young man's account of being afraid is weighed against his appearance as a potential threat.
energy_note: Too big to be frightened, apparently.

aspect: THE HONEST GAP - the scholarship is thinner than the phenomenon
description: Femicide in Mexico is well theorised and well counted. Targeted searching did not surface a comparably developed body of work on why male victims of the same violence receive less investigative attention. This row records the gap rather than filling it with assertion.

aspect: The game should let the player feel this one
description: The player as a Mexican man will be read as a threat by systems and as expendable by narrative - the same statistic used against him in both directions. That is the specific texture this difficulty setting should have, distinct from the Palestinian and Nigerian ones.
energy_note: Dangerous and disposable, from the same number.
notes: Design note: the tonal distinction between difficulty settings.

description: He explains that they came to his house and told him he would work for them. The officer asks why he did not go to the police, then asks whether he has tattoos, then asks him to describe the men again. He understands, watching the pen, that he is being assessed for membership rather than for fear.
energy_note: Describing being recruited, and being screened as a recruit.
